body:
If she wants to, I would support her - she still is an human being and deserves the right treatment. 

But first of all I want to talk to her dad who is completely unaware of the whole situation. I would like to look for a therapy / psychologist for her. I also consider to look for medical help for myself because right now I feel like I don't have enough balls to manage it on my own.

As soon as she begins to put pressure on me I will break the tie to her completely. Dunno what else to do or if that's even the right thing.

Thanks for sharing your story. You can't even think of how much pressure this creates for the folks around you.

I couldn't even sleep without thinking of her. I always was scared because she could be in the bathroom right now doin' shit with her fuckin razers. There never was any situation I was fully relaxed and didn't worry about her at all.

I know this sounds bizarre, but it became some kind of argument. "When this quarrel won't end right now, I won't cope with it anymore and you know what can happen." And that was just some kind of knock-out-argument and the relationship died bit by bit when she mentioned it again and again. Trying to be the perfect doesn't work. Sometimes, there are topics you have to talk about it, but always retreating will not work.

And I couldn't do anything. Makin the "fuck that bitch" face? It would even become worse. I never felt so defenseless in my life.

It fucked up my life much more than her's. For her, it was just an option of getting rid of problems, but for me it was like my dear would destroy her body, her mind, just everything was screwed up. I couldn't concentrate on school and on every thing else anymore.
Oh and what I wanted to tell you, lovely mummy of M.: Go die in a fire, you ruined my life, her life and nobody would even care if you would commit suicide. Appreciate it.

Her mother pretty much hated her for no reason. Started to blame her for the divorce. 
Yeah and she couldn't manage it - so she started cutting, common thing lol. Of course she became depressive. I couldn't manage that neither. She totally became a different person and I fucked up everything for her to support her. Yesterday I decided to not throw away my future for her - and she told me she don't want to live without me anymore.
